title: North Korea cites US-South Korea nuclear drill as need for stronger deterrent
detail: North Korea said a joint US-South Korea nuclear drill demonstrates the need for a stronger nuclear deterrent, per the Straits Times report.

media.caption: North Korea responds to US-South Korea nuclear drill

title: Kim Jong Un inspects new warship under construction at Nampho shipyard
detail: Kim Jong Un toured the Nampho Shipyard, where a warship larger than the 5,000-ton destroyers is under construction, and vowed to field the most advanced and powerful warships, state media reported Nov 4. Pyongyang warned continued US hostility would trigger stronger countermeasures.

media.caption: Kim inspects warship at Nampho shipyard
